# AMD FSR API headers

AMD FidelityFX SDK v2.4.0's MIT-licensed FSR API headers, unmodified: `api/` from `Kits/FidelityFX/api/include` and
`upscalers/` from `Kits/FidelityFX/upscalers/include` of tag `v2.4.0` of
<https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/FidelityFX-SDK>. Licence: `LICENSE.md` (MIT). `README.md` says what they
are for (only the headers are compiled in, `gpu/vk/vk_fsr4.cpp`; AMD's signed DLLs are not vendored). It is Hookshot's
text, kept as it was.
